summary: Iteration 14 - Re-verification of the 8 emoji-in-UI-chrome fixes from iteration 13. ALL 8 FIXES CONFIRMED APPLIED AND WORKING. Executed emoji-scans across Descubrir, EditProfile (/app/perfil/editar), PublicProfile (/app/usuario/:id), GroupDetail (/app/grupos/:id), ChatDetail propose-plan modal, Waitlist, and Onboarding step 1 (modes). No emoji characters detected in UI chrome (regex /[\u{1F300}-\u{1FAFF}\u{2600}-\u{27BF}\u{1F1E6}-\u{1F1FF}]/u) on any tested page. Distance format on Discover now reads ' · ~5 km' (dropped the leading 'a '). ChatDetail propose-plan native <select> options now show activity name only (e.g. 'Café y conversación', 'Caminata o trekking') with 0/17 emoji options. LocationPicker no longer emits '🇨🇱'; when country=CL only the comuna/city renders, else ' · <CC>' suffix (source-verified). Waitlist body copy no longer contains '🇨🇱'. GroupDetail header renders lucide Icon via emojiToIconName[group.emoji] || 'Users' (source-verified + DOM emoji-scan clean). EditProfile mode buttons (edit-mode-apoyo/amistad/amor/grupos) render lucide SVG (HeartHandshake/Smile/Heart/Users) with plain label text - no emoji. EditProfile activity chips use Icon via iconForActivity() which prefers a.icon then falls back to emojiToIconName[a.emoji]. Onboarding step 1 mode buttons (ob-mode-*) verified rendered with svg + text 'Apoyo/Amistad/Amor/Grupos' and no emoji. Onboarding activity chips (ob-act-*) verified via source (Onboarding.jsx:257 renders <Icon name={iconForActivity(a)}/>) - could not reach step 4 via UI because location step 2 requires geolocation permission or manual comuna picker (button label 'Prefiero elegirla a mano'), but the DOM scan across the reachable onboarding steps found zero emoji. REGRESSION: Login, Onboarding step navigation (step 0 alias/gender -> step 1 modes -> next), Chats list, Chat open, propose-plan modal opening, Discover render, EditProfile render, PublicProfile render, GroupDetail render, Waitlist render — all still working. System-generated chat previews on Chats still contain ☕/🎉 embedded in sys_text (backend server.py L941/L1101/L1352) — reviewer explicitly allows emojis in message content, so this is by design.
critical_code_review_comments: MODE_ICON constant is duplicated in EditProfile.jsx L13, Onboarding.jsx L13, PublicProfile.jsx L9, BottomNav, Profile.jsx. Consider hoisting into constants/comunas.js (or lib/icons.jsx) as a single source of truth (DRY).

Onboarding.jsx step 2 (location) uses geolocation which fails in the automated preview environment; the manual fallback link text 'Prefiero elegirla a mano' could be given a data-testid (e.g. loc-manual-toggle) to make onboarding-flow tests less brittle.
